## Original prompt

```text
Create a sophisticated 3:4 vertical editorial poster using the uploaded photograph. Divide the composition horizontally into two approximately equal sections, connected by a clean, seamless horizontal boundary.

UPPER HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Use the uploaded photograph directly as the photographic layer, preserving its original composition, people or objects, colors, lighting, and visual atmosphere.

Scale the photograph proportionally to fit within the upper section, ensuring the entire image remains visible without cropping or distortion. If the aspect ratios differ, fill the remaining space with warm ivory margins.

LOWER HALF — RETRO GEOMETRIC ILLUSTRATION OF THE SAME SCENE

Reinterpret the same photographic scene as a mid-century modernist editorial illustration.

Preserve the most recognizable subjects, poses, perspectives, and spatial relationships, ensuring that the illustration is immediately identifiable as a stylized interpretation of the photograph above.

Simplify visual forms using circular arcs, geometric sectors, translucent overlapping color blocks, and a few delicate compositional lines. Eliminate unnecessary background details and visual clutter.

Use a warm ivory paper background, subtle vintage printing grain, and soft ink textures, evoking the sophisticated aesthetic of a vintage design magazine's special-edition cover.

TITLE & COLOR SWATCHES

Automatically generate a meaningful two-word English title inspired by the photograph's subject and atmosphere.

Position the title in the upper-left corner of the illustration section using large, high-contrast serif typography, arranged across two lines, with one word per line.

First line: Use a deep, dark color.
Second line: Use the most distinctive accent color extracted from the original photograph.

Reserve dedicated negative space for the typography and position the main illustrated subject slightly to the right of center.

Extract five representative colors from the original photograph, including a dominant color, secondary color, accent color, dark tone, and light tone.

Use this carefully curated palette throughout the lower illustration. Display the five colors as a neatly arranged vertical column of evenly spaced, small circular swatches in the lower-left corner of the illustration section.

OVERALL AESTHETIC

Mid-century modernism, vintage editorial design, geometric abstraction, sophisticated typography, harmonious color relationships, tactile paper textures, subtle printing imperfections, balanced negative space, and timeless artistic elegance.

The only visible text should be the automatically generated two-word English title.

Final output: One complete, cohesive 3:4 vertical artistic poster that celebrates the relationship between authentic photography, geometric illustration, typography, and color.
```
